sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Link previews on MusicBrainz: drill down inside the window. A click on an entity link in the window's Extracted view (a release in a release group's list, a release's release group, a label, a recording in a tracklist…) shows that entity in the same window, and the title shows the path ("Release group › Release"). ← Back in the title bar, Backspace or Alt+← go back, from memory. Ctrl-, Shift- or middle-click still open the link in a new tab. ‹ › and ← → go on from the row the window was opened from.

sections.label: 🔧 Refactor
items: Popup engine (org/iframe.org Phase 5): the window keeps a back stack (_dpDialog.stack); _dpDrill()/_dpBack(); a drilled target never takes the page row's mark; _mbPopTarget() takes inWindow for links inside the window.
